title: endgame backend: ruins spawn, ruin capture, monument rules, monument victory
test_cmd: uv run pytest tests/services/test_ruins.py tests/services/test_oasis.py tests/services/test_round.py tests/services/test_villages.py tests/engine -q
criteria:
Endgame backend (T26a). Already present: config `cfg.ruins` (appear_day 41, count 5, min_center_distance 12, max_center_distance 40, min_gap 15, min_village_gap 4, monument_win_level 50, guardians {'stone_guard': name_th, def_inf 150, def_cav 150, count 40}); building 'monument' (kind center, max_level 50, requires palace 10, own cost_growth/time_growth); EventType.RUINS_APPEAR; TileKind.RUIN ('ruin'); oasis capture code in realm/services/oasis.py (`oasis_send_problem`, `resolve_oasis_arrival`) which uses Tile.oasis_owner_village_id as the owner column. EDITING RULE: all existing files listed above hold proofread Thai strings: change them ONLY with small targeted Edit operations (never rewrite whole files); new logic goes in the NEW file realm/services/ruins.py.

== Ruins spawn (ruins.py + worlds.py + handlers.py) ==
`realm/services/ruins.py`: `spawn_ruins(s, world_id, now, cfg) -> list[tuple[int, int]]`: world = s.get(World); None or status != 'running' or any Tile of the world already has kind 'ruin' -> return []. Candidates = Tile rows of kind 'valley' with oasis_owner_village_id NULL and no village on them (one query for tiles, one for villages) whose torus distance (realm.core.movement.distance, world.size) from (0, 0) lies in [cfg.ruins.min_center_distance, cfg.ruins.max_center_distance] and that are at least cfg.ruins.min_village_gap away from EVERY village. Sort candidates by (x, y), shuffle with random.Random(f'{world.seed}:ruins'), then greedily pick up to cfg.ruins.count tiles keeping a torus distance >= cfg.ruins.min_gap between picked ruins. Each picked tile becomes kind 'ruin' (TileKind.RUIN.value), layout None, oasis_type None, oasis_owner_village_id None, animals {guardian_key: guardian.count for each guardian in cfg.ruins.guardians}. Create one 'info' report per player of the world (bots too) titled 'ซากโบราณปรากฏขึ้น' with data {'ruins': [{'x': x, 'y': y}, ...]}; notify all players with kind 'ruins'; return the positions. `handle_ruins_appear(s, ev, cfg)` in handlers.py calls ruins.spawn_ruins(s, ev.world_id, ev.due_at, cfg) and is registered in HANDLERS. In worlds.create_world also schedule EventType.RUINS_APPEAR at game_epoch + timedelta(seconds=cfg.ruins.appear_day * 86400 / speed) with payload {}.

== Ruin attacks and capture (oasis.py + military.py small Edits) ==
Treat tiles of kind 'ruin' like oasis tiles in the existing oasis flow with these differences: send check (`_check_send` hook and `oasis.oasis_send_problem`): for ATTACK and RAID at a tile of kind 'ruin' with no village the target is valid unless the ruin's owner village belongs to the same player -> (INVALID_TARGET, 'ซากโบราณเป็นของคุณแล้ว'); there is NO radius limit and NO max-per-village limit for ruins (those two oasis rules apply only to oasis tiles). Arrival (`resolve_oasis_arrival`): defenders of an unowned ruin are the guardians (ArmyGroup stats {key: (def_inf, def_cav)} from cfg.ruins.guardians, same as animals for oases); an owned ruin has no defenders; remaining guardians are written back to tile.animals after the battle (zero entries dropped) and they do NOT respawn (the OASIS_RESPAWN handler only touches oasis tiles: make sure `respawn_oases` keeps selecting only kind 'oasis'); capture on a winning ATTACK sets tile.oasis_owner_village_id = home village id and clears animals (a RAID never captures); the previous owner village gets villages.after_change and its owner an 'info' report 'ซากโบราณของคุณถูกยึด'. Report titles for ruins: 'โจมตีซากโบราณ' / 'ปล้นซากโบราณ' / 'ยึดซากโบราณสำเร็จ' (captured); defenders entry label 'ผู้พิทักษ์' (instead of 'สัตว์ป่า'), target name 'ซากโบราณ' (instead of 'โอเอซิส'), report data key 'oasis' is replaced by 'ruin': {'captured': bool} for ruins. conquest.conquer_village already frees tiles owned by the conquered village (same column) - no change needed.

== Monument rules (villages.py) ==
Add `owns_ruin(s, village_id) -> bool` (a Tile of kind 'ruin' with oasis_owner_village_id == village_id) and `ruin_missing(s, village, btype) -> list[str]` returning ['ต้องยึดซากโบราณก่อน'] for btype 'monument' when the village owns no ruin, else []. `build()` raises REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET with that message when ruin_missing is non-empty (check it right after the normal requirements check; message exactly the string). `get_slot_view` adds the ruin_missing message to the `missing` list (and makes `affordable` False) of the monument option and of the monument upgrade.

== Victory (villages.py `complete_build`, worlds.py `end_round`, ranking.py, views.py) ==
`views.RankingRow` gets a new LAST field `monument: int = 0`. `ranking.get_ranking` computes monument = the highest level of a 'monument' Building among the player's villages (0 when none) and sorts by (monument desc, population desc, villages desc, player id asc). `worlds.end_round(s, world_id, now, cfg, winner_player_id: int | None = None, reason: str = 'round')`: when winner_player_id is given that player's ranking row is the winner (else rows[0] as today); the report data gains 'reason': reason; everything else stays. In `villages.complete_build`, AFTER the building row is applied: when the completed building type is 'monument' and the new level >= cfg.ruins.monument_win_level, call worlds.end_round(s, village.world_id, now, cfg, winner_player_id=village.player_id, reason='monument') (import worlds lazily inside the function to avoid an import cycle). get_map: for tiles of kind 'ruin' fill the same `oasis` info dict as for oases ({'owner_village_id','owned_by_me','animals'}).

== Tests == tests/services/test_ruins.py (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`; world = worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=2, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0)). Monument: build 'monument' in slot 22 of A with palace level 10 but no ruin -> REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET message 'ต้องยึดซากโบราณก่อน'; after owning a ruin (set oasis_owner_village_id) and enough stock the build succeeds and the stock drops by Res(500, 500, 500, 300) (level 1) and finishes after 3600 s at town hall 1; get_slot_view of the empty slot shows the monument option with that missing message when no ruin is owned; level 2 costs floor(500*1.1) = 550 (food floor(300*1.1) = 330); victory: insert a BuildQueue row (village A, slot 22, type 'monument', target_level 50, finishes_at t0, event_id None) with the monument Building at level 49 and call villages.complete_build(s, bq.id, t0, cfg): world.status == 'ended', world.winner_player_id == the human player id, the report data reason == 'monument'; level 49 (target_level 49) does not end the world; ROUND_END with monuments: bot 1's village has a monument Building level 5 and the human has higher population -> end_round(...) (normal path) crowns bot 1; with no monuments it is the highest population as before; ranking rows expose `monument` and are ordered monument first; map: get_map around a ruin returns the ruin tile with oasis == {'owner_village_id': None, 'owned_by_me': False, 'animals': 40}.
